einzeiler: Introduction to the true-crime podcast CRIMES OF REDDIT with Alexis and Sabrina.
kurzfassung: CRIMES OF REDDIT explores disturbing and bizarre true-crime stories sourced directly from Reddit archives. In each episode, one host presents cases while the other reacts without preparation. The podcast delves into dark and complex real-life incidents shared by actual people.
stichpunkte: Exploration of true-crime stories from Reddit
Unscripted reactions and real-time analysis of cases
Focus on disturbing and bizarre human experiences
beschreibung:
Reddit is an endless archive of humanity’s most disturbing, bizarre, and deeply human stories. If you love going down internet rabbit holes, you are going to love CRIMES OF REDDIT with Alexis Linkletter and Sabrina Deana-Roga.
Every Tuesday, one host brings a set of true-crime stories while the other reacts in real time with no prep, no spoilers asking the questions on everyone’s mind. They pull at every thread until the whole twisted picture comes into view. It’s dark, it’s messy, and the scariest part is simple: THESE ARE STORIES POSTED BY REAL PEOPLE.
Follow CRIMES OF REDDIT for a new episode every Tuesday. https://pod.link/1838511303

CRIMES OF REDDIT is a Crime House original powered by PAVE Studios.
